push.title: D 4-4 vs Realdrive Fc | You: 9.3 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 9.3, PhogsToffees. That's the sort of game that makes the whole locker room stand a little taller.

THE GOOD
+ 7 shots at Realdrive Fc's goal. You got into shooting spots again and again.
+ 2 key passes. Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ Man of the Match, your 22nd for us. Man of the Match: the highest compliment the game gives out.
+ BellyTb1 scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ That 9.3 is your 2nd best match performance of the season. Put it on the fridge.

THE BAD
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.
- Giveaways 11, up from your usual 6. That's not you at your best, and we both know it.
- 1 tackle won cost 0.1. Learn and move on.
- Shots on target: 71%. 90%+ is where the magic lives.

Pre-match routine: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

Proud of you. Go celebrate responsibly. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 33% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: 19/28 passes (68%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: D 4-4 vs Realdrive Fc | You: 7.9
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.9 is a good day. Not a great one yet, but good is the step before great.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Realdrive Fc's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ Tackle success 100%, up from your usual 40%. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ 4th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. I see you, and I like what I see.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Best practice: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. One rep at a time.
- 68% passing (19 of 28, down from your usual 79%). Try it this way: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Feet first, then flair.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- 3 tackles won dropped 0.2. Simple fix.
- Key passes: 1. One gear up gets you to 2+.

Kickabout task: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

BellyTb1, take this with you: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso
